message.text:
SSE (Server-Sent Events) is the mechanism. The hub is implemented in v1.go as SSEHub.

Now locating the hub implementation and the memo handlers that broadcast through it.

SSE is the mechanism. The hub is in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. CreateMemo and DeleteMemo broadcast via memo_service.go.

UpdateMemo also broadcasts through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. CreateMemoComment broadcasts via memo_service_comments.go. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction may also broadcast, though they are reaction handlers rather than strict memo handlers.
Checking function names around the identified line numbers.

The broadcast handlers are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment.

The SSE hub is at server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. The full set of broadcast handlers includes SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

The hub is `SSEHub` in `sse_hub.go`, mounted from `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. Create/Delete/Comment broadcast in `memo_service.go` and `memo_service_comments.go`; Update/SetAttachments/SetRelations go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go`; reaction handlers broadcast in `reaction_service.go`.
